title: Object Pose Estimation with Statistical Guarantees: Conformal Keypoint Detection and Geometric Uncertainty Propagation
summary: CVPR 2023. Uses inductive conformal prediction to turn learned keypoint heatmaps into prediction sets with a chosen coverage, then propagates those sets into a pose uncertainty set. The template for giving a learned geometric measurement a coverage-calibrated error region before it reaches a filter.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed (CVPR 2023); abstract read, full text not read
Calibration set of a few hundred labelled images is enough per the precursor paper's abstract
Code repo has no license file: read only

title: SAFEVPR: Patch-Based Verification with Empirical FDR Control for Cross-Condition Sequence Visual Place Recognition
summary: Training-free accept/abstain decision for place-recognition matches: a frozen DINOv2 patch-agreement score with Mondrian (score-binned) Learn-Then-Test calibration of accept thresholds. Targets a false-discovery rate on conditions not seen in calibration. Ground-vehicle datasets only.
key_takeaways: README claim: target FDR held on 23/23 held-out cross-condition setups at alpha 0.10
README claim: 29.6x fewer wrong loop closures, median trajectory error 95.5 m => 9.7 m
README says the control is empirical, not a formal guarantee under arbitrary shift
arXiv comment: accepted to RA-L; MIT code with a no-GPU demo

title: Conformalized Kalman Filters for State Estimation with Trustworthy Confidence Regions
summary: Preprint. Conformal calibration of Kalman-type filter confidence regions built from the filter's own first and second moments, including a quantile-regression variant and a Gaussian-mixture variant for multimodal regions. Gives sample-wise and trajectory-wise coverage statements.
key_takeaways: Abstract read; no code link on the abstract page
Trajectory-wise coverage matters when consecutive fixes share bias
Gaussian-mixture variant connects to multimodal TRN posteriors

title: Proprioceptive-only State Estimation for Legged Robots with Set-Coverage Measurements of Learned Dynamics
summary: Preprint. Replaces the Gaussian noise assumption on learned measurement models with distribution-free set-coverage statements and shows how to use them inside a Gaussian filter. Legged robots, but the mechanism transfers to any learned measurement fed to an EKF.
key_takeaways: Abstract: stays consistent where Gaussian baselines drift on real quadruped data
Abstract read only

title: Through the Lens of Doubt: Robust and Efficient Uncertainty Estimation for Visual Place Recognition
summary: Preprint. Three training-free confidence scores for any VPR method computed from the similarity-score distribution (separation, ratio spread, and a combination). Cheap inputs for a calibrated accept/abstain gate.
key_takeaways: No training, no geometric verification needed
Abstract read only

title: Formal Verification and Control with Conformal Prediction
summary: Preprint survey of conformal prediction for learning-enabled autonomous systems: verification of learned components, safe control, offline and online monitoring. Accessible entry point for a team new to conformal methods.
key_takeaways: Survey, aimed at non-experts
Useful vocabulary for a certification-minded pitch

title: Mitigating Overconfidence in Nonlinear Kalman Filters via Covariance Recalibration
summary: Proposes a covariance recalibration step that counters overconfidence in nonlinear Kalman filters. A non-conformal baseline for making filter covariance honest. arXiv journal reference: Automatica 194 (2026) 113295.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed per arXiv journal-ref; abstract only
Baseline to compare against conformal recalibration

title: Galilean State Estimation for Inertial Navigation Systems with Unknown Time Delay
summary: RSS XXII 2026. Equivariant filter using Galilean symmetry that estimates navigation states and an unknown GNSS measurement delay jointly. Validated on two fixed-wing UAVs and in simulation against an EKF with online delay estimation.
key_takeaways: Abstract: commercial receivers add unknown delays of about 50-300 ms
Abstract: fixed-wing flights with 90 ms and 120 ms lags; simulations to 500 ms
Abstract: EqF stays consistent, EKF becomes inconsistent as delay grows
No code linked on the proceedings page

title: Equivariant Symmetries for Inertial Navigation Systems
summary: Shows that the modern EKF variants for inertial navigation, including the invariant EKF, are equivariant filters with different symmetry groups, and derives GNSS-aided versions for each. The reference for choosing a symmetry for an INS filter.
key_takeaways: Preprint; repo description calls it an Automatica submission
Compares IEKF, TG-EqF and other EqFs on error and consistency
MATLAB code exists but has no license file

title: Revisiting multi-GNSS Navigation for UAVs -- An Equivariant Filtering Approach
summary: Preprint. Equivariant filter for a UAV with several GNSS antennas that also estimates each antenna's extrinsic calibration.
key_takeaways: Abstract via search snippet; full text not read

title: MSCEqF: A Multi State Constraint Equivariant Filter for Vision-aided Inertial Navigation
summary: RA-L 2023 (per arXiv comment). MSCKF-style visual-inertial navigation built as an equivariant filter. Its code and Lie group library are Apache-2.0, the permissive route into equivariant filtering.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed per arXiv comment (RA-L)
Apache-2.0 C++ code and Lie group library

title: InGVIO: A Consistent Invariant Filter for Fast and High-Accuracy GNSS-Visual-Inertial Odometry
summary: Invariant filter that tightly fuses visual-inertial data with raw GNSS and degrades to VIO as satellites drop. Datasets include a fixed-wing aircraft with raw GNSS.
key_takeaways: Search snippet says RA-L 2023; arXiv shows no journal reference
Code has no license file: read only

title: Neural Aided Adaptive Innovation-Based Invariant Kalman Filter
summary: Preprint. Combines invariant Kalman filtering with neural-aided adaptive noise estimation in the Lie-algebra tangent space, where adaptive methods had mostly been Euclidean.
key_takeaways: Abstract read only
Relevant to both the invariant-filter and the adaptive-noise directions

title: Reliable urban vehicle localization under faulty satellite navigation signals
summary: EURASIP J. Adv. Signal Process. 2024; earlier preprint arXiv 2101.06380. Particle filter with a Gaussian-mixture measurement likelihood that is robust to several faulty GNSS measurements, plus a test statistic from the particle distribution for integrity monitoring.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed; abstract only
Urban GNSS, not terrain: the TRN version is the open angle
Preprint reports fewer false alarms and lower integrity risk than an earlier PF integrity monitor

title: Error modelling method of extended Kalman filter-based terrain referenced navigation system for integrity assurance under nominal conditions
summary: IET Radar, Sonar & Navigation 16(9). Error model for EKF-based TRN integrity: radar altimeter, terrain database vertical error, lateral-offset error and interpolation error, the last two as functions of terrain roughness.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed; abstract only (author first names not read)
Spatially correlated DEM error is the term a TRN integrity test must not ignore

title: Contours-Seeking Proposal Density Particle Filter and Resilient Terrain-Referenced Navigation
summary: Preprint. Names multimodal likelihoods, nonlinear terrain and unknown prediction biases as the cause of particle filter degeneration in TRN, and adds Gaussian-mixture random forcing that nudges particles towards likely terrain contours.
key_takeaways: Abstract read only
Robustness of the PF, not integrity bounds

title: ImplicitTerrain: a Continuous Surface Model for Terrain Data Analysis
summary: Preprint. SIREN-style implicit neural representation of terrain as a continuous, differentiable surface for terrain analysis.
key_takeaways: Code repo has no license file
Baseline for neural DEM representations

title: ImplicitTerrainV2: Wavelet-Guided Spatially Adaptive Neural Terrain Representation
summary: Preprint. Adds wavelet-guided spatially adaptive frequency control, derivative-aware training and quantization plus entropy coding to neural terrain fields, aiming at a compact DEM format with good gradients.
key_takeaways: Search-snippet numbers: 1.23 bits per pixel with a 0.28 dB PSNR drop on 50 Swiss tiles
MIT code
Derivative-aware training matters for gradient-based TRN

title: Terrain-Relative Navigation with Neuro-Inspired Elevation Encoding
summary: IEEE/ION PLANS 2023. Generates position measurements from terrain elevation with NeuroGrid, a brain-inspired encoding, and fuses them with an INS using a measurement rejection rule and online covariance, motivated by the cost of storing and searching large elevation maps.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed; abstract only
Sandia listing also shows a TAES-style DOI prefix: venue metadata inconsistent

title: Loc-NeRF: Monte Carlo Localization using Neural Radiance Fields
summary: Particle-filter localization of a camera against a NeRF map. The reference for using a neural field as the map inside a Monte Carlo localizer.
key_takeaways: MIT code
Camera against a radiance field, not elevation against a DEM

title: Off-Road Navigation via Implicit Neural Representation of Terrain Traversability
summary: Preprint. Implicit neural representation of terrain properties with spatial gradients used by a gradient-based trajectory optimizer for ground robots.
key_takeaways: Ground robots and planning, not aircraft TRN
Shows neural terrain gradients used in an optimizer

title: SASGeo: Stability-Aware Semantic Map Localization for GNSS-Denied UAVs -- A Framework and Synthetic Proof of Concept
summary: Preprint. Localizes against persistent semantic structures (roads, buildings, waterways, field boundaries) with explicit positive, contradictory and unknown evidence and integrity-aware rejection of ambiguous fixes, to resist season and map age.
key_takeaways: Synthetic proof of concept only: 220 randomized trials
Abstract: global descriptor Recall@1 58.6 % vs 94.5-95.5 % for spatial semantic matching
No code link seen

title: AeroMap3D: Anchoring Monocular UAV 6-DoF Localization to Visual-Geometric-Semantic Map Priors
summary: Preprint. Monocular UAV 6-DoF localization against visual, geometric and semantic map priors; lists uncertainty-aware map updates and map-validity modelling as future work.
key_takeaways: Map-validity modelling named as open work (search snippet)
Full text not read

title: SWA-PF: Semantic-Weighted Adaptive Particle Filter for Memory-Efficient 4-DoF UAV Localization in GNSS-Denied Environments
summary: Preprint. Particle filter weighted by semantic features from UAV and satellite images, with a multi-altitude dataset (MAFS), aimed at robustness to temporally varying scenes and low-resolution maps.
key_takeaways: Abstract: errors below 10 m and 10x efficiency over feature extraction methods
Code repo has no license file; MAFS terms not checked

title: OrthoLoC: UAV 6-DoF Localization and Calibration Using Orthographic Geodata
summary: NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks. UAV images paired with orthophotos and surface models so localization and calibration can be evaluated without the retrieval step; also proposes a matcher-agnostic refinement (AdHoP).
key_takeaways: Abstract: 16,425 UAV images over 47 regions in Germany and the US
Repo LICENSE is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: evaluation only, no commercial use
Project page states about 287 GB (not checked)

title: MegaLoc: One Retrieval to Place Them All
summary: Preprint. A single image-retrieval model trained across many localization datasets, meant as a general retrieval front end for VPR and visual localization.
key_takeaways: MIT code; weight terms not checked separately
Candidate retrieval stage to compare with AnyLoc and DINOv2 GeM

title: VFM-Loc: Training-Free Cross-View Geo-Localization via Aligning Discriminative Visual Hierarchies
summary: Preprint. Training-free drone-to-satellite cross-view geo-localization with vision foundation model features, multi-scale pooling and a domain-wise PCA plus Procrustes alignment.
key_takeaways: Abstract: over 20 % Recall@1 above supervised methods on the large-oblique LO-UCV set
No code link seen

title: (MGS)^2-Net: Unifying Micro-Geometric Scale and Macro-Geometric Structure for Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Preprint. Cross-view geo-localization that attributes RGB foundation-feature failures to oblique-to-orthographic misalignment such as building facades invisible in orthophotos.
key_takeaways: Failure-mode argument from a search snippet; full text not read

title: Learning Cross-view Visual Geo-localization without Ground Truth
summary: Preprint. Self-supervised adaptation of frozen foundation models for drone-to-satellite geo-localization; reports that frozen features work drone-to-drone but drop sharply drone-to-satellite.
key_takeaways: Failure observation from a search snippet; full text not read

title: Unsupervised Multi-view UAV Image Geo-localization via Iterative Rendering
summary: Preprint. Builds a 3D Gaussian splatting model from oblique UAV views and iteratively renders a satellite-like view to align with the real satellite image.
key_takeaways: Render-and-compare route to cross-view matching; GPU-heavy

title: Navigation by Skylight Polarization via Rayleigh Model Optimization on a Road Vehicle
summary: Preprint. Skylight polarization navigation on a road vehicle using optimization against the Rayleigh sky model. Recent evidence that polarization heading is being tested outside the lab.
key_takeaways: Title and metadata only; abstract not read
Ground vehicle, not aircraft

title: An Adaptive Sliding Window Estimator for Positioning of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Using a Single Anchor
summary: Preprint. UAV positioning from a single UWB anchor, optical flow and IMU in a sliding-window estimator whose motion model includes aerodynamic drag with an adjusted drag matrix.
key_takeaways: Abstract via search snippet: drag in the motion model is called crucial
Minimal-sensor example that already mixes flow and drag

title: An Innovation-Based Approach to Detect Stealthy Disturbance Attacks in Maritime Monitoring
summary: Preprint. A statistical detection suite on Kalman filter innovations that tests whiteness and other properties, to catch stealthy disturbances that keep the normalized innovation squared in range.
key_takeaways: Abstract read; maritime setting
Whiteness tests as a counter to attacks tuned against NIS-only gates and adaptive R

title: Real-Time Bayesian Detection of Drift-Evasive GNSS Spoofing in Reinforcement Learning Based UAV Deconfliction
summary: Preprint. Detects slow drift-evasive GNSS spoofing with Bayesian change-point detection in a UAV deconfliction setting.
key_takeaways: Title and search snippet only
Example of slow coherent spoofing as the hard case

title: Recursive Noise Adaptive Kalman Filtering by Variational Bayesian Approximations
summary: IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control 2009. The variational Bayes adaptive Kalman filter that estimates measurement noise variance jointly with the state. Baseline for any adaptive-noise direction.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed; metadata checked via Crossref, paper not opened
Adapts R from innovations, which a coherent spoof can exploit

title: A Novel Adaptive Kalman Filter With Inaccurate Process and Measurement Noise Covariance Matrices
summary: IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control 2018. Variational Bayes adaptive Kalman filter that treats both the predicted covariance and the measurement noise covariance as uncertain (inverse-Wishart). Widely used base for GNSS/INS adaptive filters.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed; metadata checked via Crossref (author surnames), paper not opened

title: An Efficient Schmidt-EKF for 3D Visual-Inertial SLAM
summary: CVPR 2019. Treats prior-map features as Schmidt (consider) states: their covariance and cross-correlations enter the update without being estimated, keeping the filter consistent and cheap.
key_takeaways: Peer-reviewed (CVPR 2019)
Pattern for correlated map georeferencing error without growing the state
